property_summary: For any recipient address whose fallback reverts, the correct contract (using transfer) will revert withdrawAll (so call fails) while the mutant (using unchecked call) will not revert and will keep contract balance unchanged; thus reference always reverts when callee reverts, but mutant sometimes does not.
change_summary: Replace transfer with low-level call forwarding all gas and not reverting on failure, changing observable reversion behavior and final balances.
